prompt.content: You are a protein engineer specializing in thermostable proteins. Design sequences optimized for high-temperature stability.

Design a thermostable protein of 200 amino acids. The protein should have high proline content (>5%), increased charged residues (R, K, D, E >25%), and a molecular weight around 22,000 Da. Include a zinc-binding motif (H-X-X-H).

prompt.content: You are a synthetic biologist. Design DNA sequences optimized for protein expression in E. coli.

Design a DNA sequence (CDS) of 300 nucleotides that encodes a soluble, highly expressed protein in E. coli. The GC content should be around 52%. Use optimal E. coli codons. Include a ribosome binding site (AAGGAG) upstream.

items.answer: RNA aptamer with G-quadruplex motif, GC ~65%, 80 nt

prompt.content: You are an RNA engineer. Design RNA sequences with specific structural properties.

Design an RNA aptamer of 80 nucleotides that is rich in G-C base pairs for stability (GC content ~65%). The sequence should contain a G-quadruplex forming motif (GGG-N-GGG-N-GGG). The RNA should have low self-complementarity outside the structured region.
